input.summary: All 31 controls are now settled or handed to the user. Movement, shooting direction, bomb placement, back/start, and the drop-item hold on left_control were bound from strongly lopsided cross-game habit evidence (evidenced). Three genuinely split jobs were sent to the user: pocket-item use on kb_q, the held drop-item action on kb_left_control, and the held drop-item action on right_trigger, which showed an even split between a mouth action and a joystick push. The 13 controls with no documented function in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance/Rebirth (A, B, X, Y, kb_f, dpad_N, dpad_S, kb_c, kb_f1, kb_h, kb_left_shift, kb_x, mouse_right_button) were bound to the device's null input ('none') so they stay inert rather than being given an invented purpose.
